audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6, first item and two items were all given to Pantheon, while whys[4] says you out-burst him, whys[5] calls first item 'your peak' and whys[6] says he falls off and you out-trade him.
audit.why: 53.18% over 299 games with a front-loaded enemy: Pantheon owns levels 1-3, the lane evens at 4-5, and every stage from Slicing Maelstrom onward belongs to Kennen because Pantheon's armour-first build does nothing against magic. The packet chart says the same.
audit.corrected: L1 Skill, L2-L3 Pantheon, Levels 4-5 Skill, L6 Kennen, first item Kennen, 2+ items Kennen.

audit.why: Spike order is right: Pantheon 1-3, Kennen at 6 and first item, Kennen late. Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s against Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s, so from level 6 Kennen has an ult available for more fights than Pantheon does.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early block and wants.foe[2] say Pantheon's passive blocks your auto attacks from one direction. It does not: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts. The frontal invulnerability is Aegis Assault (E), and the text never mentions that it is a channel your stun cancels.
audit.why: Riot text: P Mortal Will 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' E Aegis Assault, 400 range, 22/21/20/19/18s, 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front', carrying shield, untargetable and channel flags. The missingInteractions rules channel-interruptible and untargetable-dodges-burst both point here. W Shield Vault is a 600-range dash stun on 13/12/11/10/9s with an auto reset.
audit.corrected: Autos are not blocked by his passive; what blanks your burst is Aegis Assault on a 22s cooldown at rank 1 — and because it is a channel, your third Mark of the Storm stun cancels it outright instead of being wasted into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks only Shield Vault, but the punishing cooldown in this lane is Aegis Assault at 22s.
audit.why: 13s on the stun dash versus 22s on the defensive channel: the long one is the one you fight around, and the one whose absence guarantees your combo connects.
audit.corrected: Commit when Aegis Assault is down, not merely when Shield Vault is.

edits.before: Pantheon owns the first three levels and you have to respect it. His W is a point-click stun — there is no skillshot to dodge — so the second you step into melee range to throw an auto or chase a mark, he can stun-and-burst you with empowered Q. Farm with the tip of your Q (Thundering Shuriken) from max range and let Electrical Surge autos chip only when his W is on cooldown. His passive blocks your auto attacks from one direction, so don't rely on autos to build Mark of the Storm here — lead with Q. Eat a little poke; you don't have the stun chain or the body to fight him yet.
edits.after: Pantheon owns the first three levels and you have to respect it. Shield Vault (W) is a point-click stun dash at 600 range — there is no skillshot to dodge — so the second you step up to auto or chase a mark, he stuns and bursts you with an empowered Q. Farm with the tip of your Q (Thundering Shuriken) and let Electrical Surge autos chip only in his 13s W window. Aegis Assault (E) makes him invulnerable from the front, so never feed autos into the shield — lead with Q. Eat a little poke; you don't have the stun chain or the body to fight him yet.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are even — keep landing Q pokes and stacking marks from range while you wait for your spike. At 6 the lane flips hard: Slicing Maelstrom plus your Mark of the Storm chain means you can E-in (or Flash), drop R, and stun-lock him while your AoE storm and magic burst delete a squishy Pantheon who has no MR and an armor-heavy early build that does nothing against you. Bait his W-stun and E disengage, then commit your full Q-W-E-R combo the moment it is down. This is the window to turn his early lead around.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even — keep landing Q pokes and stacking marks from range while you wait for your spike. At 6 the lane flips hard: Slicing Maelstrom plus your Mark of the Storm chain means you can E-in (or Flash), drop R, and stun-lock him while your AoE storm and magic burst delete a squishy Pantheon who has no MR and an armor-heavy early build that does nothing against you. Bait Shield Vault (13s) and Aegis Assault (22s at rank 1), then commit everything. This is the window to turn his early lead around.

edits.before: Reach level 6 and cash the Q-W-E-Flash-R stun-lock before he can disengage
edits.after: Reach 6 and stun him out of Aegis Assault — the third mark cancels his channel

edits.after: Hide behind Aegis Assault to blank your burst, then all-in on a missed Q
